sql: SELECT tt,title,year FROM b_imdb_title WHERE norm_title=? ORDER BY year DESC,rating DESC,votes DESC,tt ASC LIMIT 25
SELECT tt,title,year FROM b_imdb_title WHERE norm_title LIKE ? ORDER BY CASE WHEN norm_title=? THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,year DESC,rating DESC,votes DESC,tt ASC LIMIT 25
coverage: Native ImdbCatalog.cpp search currently binds normalized text plus % (prefix)

sql: SELECT tt,title,year FROM b_imdb_title WHERE norm_title LIKE ? ORDER BY year DESC,rating DESC,votes DESC,tt ASC LIMIT 25
coverage: Requested substring workload; additional semantic case, not a claim that native search is substring

sql: SELECT tt,title,year FROM b_imdb_title WHERE title LIKE ? ORDER BY tt LIMIT 25
coverage: Real-source Unicode display-title pattern; separate from ASCII-normalized native lookup

sql: SELECT tt,title,year FROM b_imdb_title WHERE year IS NULL OR rating IS NULL ORDER BY tt LIMIT 25
coverage: Null preservation; may return zero on this snapshot

sql: SELECT t.tt,t.title,t.year FROM b_imdb_title t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_imdb_genre g WHERE g.tt=t.tt AND g.genre=?) ORDER BY t.votes DESC,t.tt ASC LIMIT 25
coverage: Genre membership and vote ordering over sampled roots

sql: SELECT m.mal_id,m.title,m.members,m.score,m.explicit FROM b_mal_manga m WHERE m.explicit=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_mal_classification c WHERE c.medium='manga' AND c.mal_id=m.mal_id AND c.axis=? AND LOWER(c.value)=LOWER(?)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_mal_classification c WHERE c.medium='manga' AND c.mal_id=m.mal_id AND c.axis=? AND LOWER(c.value)=LOWER(?)) ORDER BY m.members DESC,COALESCE(m.score,0) DESC,m.mal_id ASC LIMIT 25
coverage: Manga AND genre/demographic facets, case folding and explicit gate

sql: SELECT CAST(AVG(m.score) AS TEXT),COUNT(*) FROM b_mal_manga m WHERE m.explicit=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_mal_classification c WHERE c.medium='manga' AND c.mal_id=m.mal_id AND c.axis=? AND LOWER(c.value)=LOWER(?))
coverage: Same-population mean/count prerequisite; sample-scoped, not full catalogue mean

sql: WITH scoped AS (SELECT m.* FROM b_mal_manga m WHERE m.explicit=0 AND m.score IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_mal_classification c WHERE c.medium='manga' AND c.mal_id=m.mal_id AND c.axis=? AND LOWER(c.value)=LOWER(?)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_mal_classification c WHERE c.medium='manga' AND c.mal_id=m.mal_id AND c.axis=? AND LOWER(c.value)=LOWER(?))), mean AS (SELECT AVG(score) c FROM scoped) SELECT m.mal_id,m.title,m.score,m.scored_by FROM scoped m ORDER BY ((CAST(m.scored_by AS REAL)/(m.scored_by+3000.0))*m.score+(3000.0/(CAST(m.scored_by AS REAL)+3000.0))*(SELECT c FROM mean)) DESC,m.mal_id ASC LIMIT 25
coverage: Bayesian confidence floor 3000 and mean over identical sampled AND-facet scope; not full-catalogue ranking

sql: SELECT a.mal_id,a.title,a.members FROM b_mal_anime a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_mal_classification c WHERE c.medium='anime' AND c.mal_id=a.mal_id AND LOWER(c.value)=LOWER(?)) ORDER BY a.members DESC,a.mal_id LIMIT 25
coverage: Anime membership via full axis-bearing classification closure; not all native anime filters

sql: SELECT s.gcd_id,s.title,s.year,COALESCE(t.downloads,0) FROM b_comics_series s LEFT JOIN b_comics_stats t ON t.series_id=s.gcd_id WHERE s.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' AND s.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(s.title)=LOWER(?) THEN 0 WHEN s.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,COALESCE(t.downloads,0) DESC,s.year DESC,s.gcd_id LIMIT 25
coverage: Escaped all-word search and exact/prefix ranking; added ID tie-break for reproducibility

sql: SELECT gcd_id,title FROM b_comics_series WHERE title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY gcd_id LIMIT 25
coverage: Literal percent/underscore input; real-source negative probe may return zero

sql: SELECT d.post_id,d.title,d.date,m.url,m.host,m.label FROM b_comics_download d LEFT JOIN b_comics_mirror m ON m.post_id=d.post_id WHERE d.series_id=? ORDER BY d.date DESC,d.post_id DESC,m.source_rowid ASC
coverage: Complete sampled-series download/mirror closure, explicit source mirror ordering

sql: SELECT mal_id,volume_count,count_basis FROM b_tankoban_series WHERE mal_id=?

WITH RECURSIVE seq(n,maxn) AS (SELECT 1,volume_count FROM b_tankoban_series WHERE mal_id=? AND volume_count>0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,maxn FROM seq WHERE n<maxn), emitted AS (SELECT CAST(n AS TEXT) number FROM seq), all_numbers AS (SELECT number FROM emitted UNION SELECT number FROM b_tankoban_volumes WHERE mal_id=?) SELECT a.number,COALESCE(v.cover_url,''),COALESCE(v.name,'') FROM all_numbers a LEFT JOIN b_tankoban_volumes v ON v.number=a.number AND v.mal_id=? ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.number IN(SELECT number FROM emitted) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,CASE WHEN a.number IN(SELECT number FROM emitted) THEN CAST(a.number AS INTEGER) END,a.number
coverage: SQL equivalent of synthesized 1..N plus exact-string baked overlay and out-of-range extras; native post-sort remains separately unproved
